blockingFindings.title: State-transition contract covers Change only, not Delivery and Run
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Extend Q6 and acceptance/test plan with separate typed transition tables and exhaustive valid/invalid matrix tests for all three entities. Delivery: active -> completed | cancelled. Change: as currently stated. Run: pending -> completed | failed | cancelled. Terminal states have no outgoing edges. B1 owns structural edges only; semantic prerequisites belong to D1 Policy.
